Because the noble truths, the meditative absorptions, the immeasurables, the formless attainments, the liberations, the attainments of successive abiding, emptiness, signlessness, wishlessness, the superknowledges, the concentrations, the dhāraṇī-doors, the powers of the Tathāgata, the fearlessnesses, the analytical knowledges, great love, great compassion and the unmixed qualities of a buddha are pure, [everything] up to feeling conditioned by mental contact is pure. Because feeling conditioned by mental contact is pure, omniscience is pure. Thus the purity of the unmixed qualities of a buddha, the purity of feeling conditioned by mental contact, and the purity of omniscience: in this there is no duality, it cannot be made two, it is not separate, it is not different.
